lastTask: Implement Track A4 candidate development hook

projectState.summary: Track A4 is implemented on codex/byte-a4-development-hook. The branch adds developCandidate() to clone an elite same-branch phrase parent, deep-clone its genome, apply a closed bounded phrase.nudge mutation, and create a new alive child candidate with parentId, generation+1, empty scores, fitness 0, and caller-provided or derived deterministic seed. Child creation is audited through candidate.created with reason:"development", parentId, and normalized mutation. The endpoint/client/window hook are inspect-only; no audio/model/playback/scoring loop consumes developed children. Validation: build green, db:smoke green, smoke 43/43, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
